notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
